_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for piercewallar.com career facts. Edit this file, then run:  python scripts/build_career.py
That regenerates js/experience-data.js, data/career-facts.md and the JSON-LD block in index.html. Commit the outputs.
Search this file for EDIT: to find prose still waiting on you. Dates are [year, month]; the end month counts. Use "present" for a current role.
Segment and entry date strings are derived from the numbers, so fix a date once and every output follows.

entries.label: Newmark
entries.summary: Management consulting work in real estate, where the quality of the underlying data decided whether anything built on it could be trusted.
bullets: Took responsibility for cleaning up a client's Master Entity List, standardizing roughly 550 real estate entities into a consistent five-digit ID scheme and verifying it against the client's hierarchy diagram.

Traced numbers stored as text that were breaking lookup formulas across thousands of rows, corrected the cause systematically, and documented four quality issues for the team to resolve with the client.
Built a UAT and DCT testing progress tracker for a client deliverable, with status roll-ups, donut and stacked bar charts, and a one-click refresh.

entries.label: Green Tree Risk Group
entries.summary: Early-stage groundwork for an insurtech company built around AI liability and cyber insurance: a managing general agent (MGA) platform paired with AI governance software.
bullets: Coordinated weekly customer discovery interview rounds across a team of six, with more than ten interviews grounding the Business Model Canvas.
Built the six-year financial model from scratch, including partnership structures, a detailed expense build, and a balanced balance sheet, with cell-level source notes for every assumption.
Developed a valuation approach based on public market multiples that values the underwriting and software businesses separately and then combines them.
Led work on market sizing, pricing benchmarks, and the company's name and brand identity, and produced a pitch deck and brand guidelines.
entries.note: Status: groundwork concluded in May 2026, when the founding team moved on to other pursuits.

Independently performed twice-weekly site safety audits at 4 chemical plants, totaling over 300 audits, while advising executive leadership on programs and initiatives to address current and changing environmental, health, and safety risks.
